subject: BrightlyHealth marketplace renewal & PO timing
message_1_subject: Renewal + marketplace PO timing and capacity increase
message_1_body:
Hi Sergio,

We’re coming up on our annual renewal and BrightlyHealth is planning to increase committed capacity by ~20% for the next 12 months. We currently transact via AWS Marketplace and would like to move forward with a private offer (PO) so our procurement team can manage invoicing and fiscal timing.

Requests from procurement: 
- Split invoices across three tranches aligned to our fiscal quarters (Jul, Oct, Jan).
- 12-month term but flexible acceptance windows for staged activation.
- A short proforma showing pricing and credits for the additional capacity.

I’ve attached our PO requirements and the procurement contact is cc’d (Michael Patterson). Can you confirm Redwood’s process for private-offer paperwork and whether we can do staggered invoices?

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Chen
Director of Procurement, BrightlyHealth
Attachment: Brightly_PO_requirements.pdf
message_2_cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
message_2_subject: Re: Renewal + marketplace PO timing and capacity increase
message_2_body:
Laura — thanks for the clear note and attachment. Summary / next steps from Redwood: 

1) We can support a private offer on AWS Marketplace and structure invoices as multiple tranches (we typically do 2–4 tranches per PO).
2) We’ll provide a proforma with the uplift pricing and proposed credits; I’ll include an acceptance schedule that maps to the three tranche dates you listed.
3) Kimberly (billing) will own the invoice cadence & tax framing; Priyom will coordinate the private offer paperwork with AWS; Naomi is on renewals and will own the signature/DocuSign flow.

I attached a quick worksheet so we can capture committed units, target activation dates, and where credits should apply. Can you confirm the committed token / unit numbers you expect for year one and whether the 20% uplift is on top of current committed spend or incremental usage?

If you prefer a call to walk procurement through the flow I can set 30 minutes — otherwise we’ll send the proforma + DocuSign envelope by end of day Friday.

Best,
Sergio
VP, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Renewal_worksheet.xlsx

message_3_subject: FW: BrightlyHealth PO requirements — tranche / acceptance options
message_3_body:
Folks — forwarding Brightly’s ask (attached). Key constraints: three tranches, 12-month term, staged activation/acceptance windows. Questions: 

- Can we propose a 3-tranche invoice schedule that maps to their fiscal quarters but keeps a single acceptance window per tranche? (i.e., tranche invoiced on Jul 1, Oct 1, Jan 1; each tranche has a 45-day acceptance window)
- Any red flags from AWS private offer experience — do we need a separate marketplace acceptance playbook for a staged activation?
- Kimberly, what is the minimum lead time for us to create the PO & invoice tranches on our side (and does that change if they require tax split lines)?

I’ll draft a short proforma and the suggested acceptance cadence after you confirm the feasible timelines.

Thanks,
Sergio
message_4_subject: Re: FW: BrightlyHealth PO requirements — tranche / acceptance options
message_4_body:
Sergio / Priyom — we can support the 3-tranche plan with the following guardrails: 

- Invoice tranches on Jul 1, Oct 1, Jan 1. Each tranche will be net-30 from invoice date.
- Acceptance windows: 45 days for each tranche; failure to accept moves usage to a default post-acceptance billing rate (we’ll include this clause in the SOW).
- For AWS private offers we need: customer billing contact, legal entity name, tax ID, and a signed private-offer acceptance form. Priyom will need to file the private offer with AWS and that typically takes 5–7 business days once paperwork is complete.

Action items: 
- Priyom will prepare the marketplace PO template and start the AWS submission.
- Sergio to send proforma confirming pricing and credits.
- Naomi to prepare DocuSign envelope with the three-tranche billing appendix.

Attachment: Marketplace_PO_Template.docx

Kimberly
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
message_5_cc: Michael Patterson <mpatterson@brightlyhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
message_5_subject: Re: Renewal + marketplace PO timing and capacity increase
message_5_body:
Thanks — that plan works for us.

We accept the 3-tranche schedule and the 45-day acceptance windows. Michael (procurement) is cc’d and will own PO issuance. Please send the proforma and DocuSign envelope; procurement prefers a single DocuSign that references the three invoice tranches and includes the private-offer data for AWS.

Requested items for the proforma: 
- Line-item breakdown (current commit vs proposed uplift)
- Applied credit(s) for existing multi-year discount
- Tax line and billing entity details

We’ll aim to have the signed PO back within two weeks of receiving the DocuSign. HubSpot deal ID is BRIGHTLY-2026 if you need to link records: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/BRIGHTLY-2026

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Laura
